text_sanskrit: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ । माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः ॥ १-१४ ॥
itrans: tataH shvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau . mAdhavaH pANDavashchaiva divyau sha~Nkhau pradadhmatuH .. 1-14 ..
translation: Then seated in their great chariot yoked to white horses, Madhava and the Pandaya (Arjuna) blew their divine conches.
